text: Explaining the gap didn't fix anything. Five accounts still hold standing, unrevoked admin access fourteen months after the incident ended. The fix is revoking it -- under Hartwell's change-management process, with a ticket and a scheduled maintenance window.

On Azure, Remove-MgUserAppRoleAssignment removes a direct Entra ID role grant. On AWS, aws iam detach-user-policy removes a policy attached straight to a user rather than inherited through a group. Each of the 5 removals is logged against this finding.

Validation means re-measuring, not assuming. Mara re-runs a corrected manual review -- checking both group membership and direct assignment -- and re-runs the Python automation against the same segment.
Both now report 14, with zero direct assignments remaining. The automation dropped from 19 to 14. Two independent methods agreeing for the first time is the actual proof the fix worked.
